title: Six-block multinomial moment bound
statement: Let $n$ and $d$ be nonnegative integers with $6d\\le n$. The multinomial coefficient with six parts of size $d$ and a seventh part of size $n-6d$ is at most the fourth moment, under the uniform probability distribution on the $n$-dimensional sign cube, of the sum of all degree-$3d$ monomials.
